blocks.title: Unit testing
blocks.text: Unit testing is the first level of testing: individual components or modules are tested in isolation. Each unit is a small, testable part of the software, such as a function or method, and the goal is to check that each one works correctly according to its design.
Class activity: try writing a unit test for a simple function in your favourite programming language.
